title: Mikakunin de Shinkoukei: Mite. Are ga Watashitachi no Tomatteiru Ryokan yo.
justification: AniList 20633 (OVA, 1 episode from 2014-03-19, 12 min) is AniDB 10110's special S1 Mite. Are ga Watashitachi no Tomatte Iru Ryokan yo. (Look. It's the Inn Where We Are Staying.), aired 2014-03-19. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 20483, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 10110, and the special's title matches AniList's romaji, English and native titles. The parent has no row for S1, so it lands on TVDB 0x1 Look. That's the Inn Where We're Staying. (2014-03-19) and on TMDB 75992 S0E1 (2014-03-19, 12 min).
